payload.answer:
Import the certification file into the agent by doing the following command:

Note : You can use either .cer or .pem. 
Make sure the file is in ASCII not binary. 
Where the /usr/ITM/JRE is your Java location and <fileName> is your file name.

ex: 
/usr/ITM/JRE/aix526/jre/bin/keytool -import -trustcacerts -alias 
ligitalsso -keystore /usr/ITM/JRE/aix526/jre/bin/lib/security/cacerts 
-storepass <fileName> -file /NEWSSL-sscert.cer [S1]

source_lineage.excerpt:
Import the certification file into the agent by doing the following command:

Note : You can use either .cer or .pem. 
Make sure the file is in ASCII not binary. 
Where the /usr/ITM/JRE is your Java location and <fileName> is your file name.

ex: 
/usr/ITM/JRE/aix526/jre/bin/keytool -import -trustcacerts -alias 
ligitalsso -keystore /usr/ITM/JRE/aix526/jre/bin/lib/security/cacerts 
-storepass <fileName> -file /NEWSSL-sscert.cer

1. Attached zip file includes the instruction of how to generate a new certificate. 


Generate a new certificate for Tivoli DP agent.zip [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21646081&aid=2]Generate a new certificate for Tivoli DP agent.zip [/support/docview.wss?uid=swg21646081&aid=1]

* For DataPower agent v7.1 FP1 (include IF01 and IF02) and earlier version -

Agent can not import the certficate automatically. So we need import the valid certificate via command keytool and provide an alias for every certificate. For different certificate, you can provide different alias. 

*** For FP1 or earlier version, you need import the certificates via the command as below 

/opt/IBM/ITMCHL/JRE/lx8266/bin/keytool -import -trustcacerts -alias ligitalsso -keystore /opt/IBM/ITMCHL/JRE/lx8266/lib/security/cacerts -storepass changeit -file /NEWSSL-sscert.pem 

ligitalsso is alias, and /NEWSSL-sscert.pem is the path of certificate. 

You can provide different for different certificate.  

PRODUCT ALIAS/SYNONYM
 ITCAM Agent for DataPower

Please provide following from each environment that is experiencing the problem :


 1. Platform and version number.
2. MachineType and Appliance Firmware level. 
3. The result of following command from '<ITM_HOME>/bin' directory 
from all the machines (Agent, ITM product) related to this issue. 
"cinfo -i" from UNIX platform 
"kincinfo -i" from Windows platform 
4. Detailed description of problem and STEP BY STEP problem recreation senario.
(Messages and other information displaced in screen)
5. If System stops on UNIX system, zip up the core dumps from Agent for DP installed machine 
at <ITM_HOME>/bin directory.
6. Helpful screenshots if appropriate. 
7. Export of "SNMP Settings" on the device. 

8. Logs/config files - Please send following information from Agent for DP installed machine, 

 * Agent Log - Output of <ITM_HOME>/bin/pdcollect 
 * Zip up the Agent Configuration files as below Logs Type Location of logs. Agent Config files * Windows :
   <ITM_HOME>\TMAITM6\*.cfg 
   * Unix/Linux :
   <ITM_HOME>/config/*.cfg

ANSWER
The ITCAM for Data Power agent version 6.3 went EOS in April 2014 since the container 

 package (ITCAM for SOA platform version 6.2.2) service is ended.

IBM Detailed System Requirements for ITCAM Agent for DataPower - United States

CAMDPALL CAMDPENV Detailed Requirement System Agent Data Power "Agent for Data Power" Software Hardware BN TECHNOTE (FAQ)

QUESTION
 The supported version of Operating Systems and Data Power appliances (for ITCAM Agent for Data Power) 

ANSWER

APAR: IV68831
Abstract: CERTIFICATE CAN NOT BE ADDED TO KEYSTORE AUTOMATICALLY.
Additional Information: If customer use customed certificate to replace the default certificate, agent cannot add the configured certificate to
keystore automatically. 

APAR: IV63703 
Abstract: KD4DP0004E THE DATA COLLECTOR COULD NOT RETRIEVE A DOMAIN LIST FOR DATAPOWER APPLIANCE 
Additional Information: DataPower data collector does not receive data from some DataPower appliances, the following error appears in the data collector operations log: 
KD4DP0004E The data collector could not retrieve a domain list for the DataPower appliance: <DataPower DNS or IP> using user ID: <user id>. 
Detailed error message: class 
javax.net.ssl.SSLHandshakeException Server chose TLSv1, 
but that protocol version is not enabled or supported by the client.
